scope: Desktop completion matrix for all production-reachable authenticated dashboard surfaces: navigation, layout, CRUD/actions regression hooks, loading/empty/error/success, dialogs/forms/tables, overflow, basic a11y, authenticated E2E evidence.

contracts.authShell: Protected routes require session; unauthenticated users Navigate to /login.
contracts.noOverflow: Primary authenticated pages must not horizontal-overflow at desktop width.
contracts.e2eEvidence: Each surface maps to at least one authenticated Playwright spec or is explicitly classified as DEV catalog-only with shell coverage.
contracts.a11yBasics: Interactive controls expose accessible names (role/button/link); lang=de on html.
contracts.errorVisible: Failures use ApiError/toast/inline danger — Stage 29 taxonomy.
contracts.stageBoundary: Deep mobile-only viewports are Stages 31-35; desktop gate freezes 1280 baseline.

surfaces.states: loading via auth; error via Discord OAuth return

surfaces.e2e: dashboard-authenticated-page-matrix; economy-*; whitelist-*; killfeed-*; casino-*; factions-*; tickets-*; welcome-goodbye-*; settings-*; permissions-*; lottery-*; virtual-accounts-*; black-market-*; feeds-*; embed-*; reaction-*; translated-posts-*; server-aliases-*

surfaces.states: session lock; tool routes from DEV_TOOLS
surfaces.e2e: dev-shell-authenticated.spec.ts; dev-observability-*; dev-sensitive-actions-*; dev-command-center-*; dev-nitrado-mirror-*; dev-diagnostics-*; dev-upload-crud-*

desktopChecks.description: Authenticated core routes render markers without horizontal overflow at default Playwright viewport
Explicit 1280x800 pass for /servers, guild, slot settings
App.tsx registers login, servers, guild, slot, bot-admin, dev tree; catch-all to /servers
Every DEV_TOOLS slug has DEV_PAGES mapping (console.error gate on missing)

residualRisks: Not every Bot-Admin sub-panel has a dedicated desktop screenshot audit; covered by bot-admin-core + architecture inventories from Stages 26-29.
Full WCAG audit deferred beyond basic names/lang/touch — acceptable for Stage 30 scope.
